title: docs: Miscellaneous Developer's Guide updates
description:
In the Developer's Guide: Update the minimum macOS version support. Note
that Chocolatey doesn't support Arm64 packages. Prefer CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
over WIRESHARK_QT6_PREFIX_PATH. Add some block attributes.

In README.developer: Note that we recommend Qt 6. Don't bother
mentioning tmpnam. It's not likely to be used and we prohibit it in
CheckAPIs.pl.
